17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk; ch. 169 converted only the treasurer

Town of Williamstown, Town Officers page (williamstownvt.org): Town Clerk Barbara Graham (term expiring 2028)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 169 (Town of Williamstown): sec. 1-2: the elective Town Treasurer was converted to a Selectboard-appointed position (eff. May 7, 2012)
Town of Williamstown, Town Officers page (williamstownvt.org): under Appointed Town Officers -- Town Treasurer Jenn Allard
